notes.text: The linked Yoma gives Yehudah bar Grogerot teaching about sitting on wet clay on Yom Kippur. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1671&lang=en) locates the teaching on 78a and gives the name as Yehudah Gerogeret.
